passages.text: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A Miktam of David, when he fled from Saul into the cave.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this song.
David fled from Saul.
David hid in a cave.
This is a Miktam, a special type of psalm.
The choirmaster should lead this song.
The tune is called “Do Not Destroy.”

passages.text: Have mercy on me, O God, have mercy, for in You my soul takes refuge. In the shadow of Your wings I will take shelter until the danger has passed.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
David fled from Saul.
David hid in a cave.
David spoke to God.
David said, “Have mercy on me, God.”
David asked for mercy again.
David said, “My soul finds refuge in You.”
David said, “I will take shelter in the shadow of Your wings.”
David said, “I will stay there until the danger passes.”
passages.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֣חַ אַל־ תַּ֭שְׁחֵת לְדָוִ֣ד מִכְתָּ֑ם בְּבָרְח֥וֹ מִפְּנֵי־ שָׁ֝א֗וּל בַּמְּעָרָֽה׃ חָנֵּ֤נִי אֱלֹהִ֨ים׀ חָנֵּ֗נִי כִּ֥י בְךָ֮ חָסָ֪יָה נַ֫פְשִׁ֥י וּבְצֵֽל־ כְּנָפֶ֥יךָ אֶחְסֶ֑ה עַ֝֗ד יַעֲבֹ֥ר הַוּֽוֹת׃

passages.text: I cry out to God Most High, to God who fulfills His purpose for me.
passages.sermon:
David is the speaker.
David is hiding from Saul in a cave.
David is in danger.
David cries out to God Most High.
God is above all.
God fulfills His purpose for David.
God acts for David.
passages.original: אֶ֭קְרָא לֵֽאלֹהִ֣ים עֶלְי֑וֹן לָ֝אֵ֗ל גֹּמֵ֥ר עָלָֽי׃

passages.text: He reaches down from heaven and saves me; He rebukes those who trample me. Selah God sends forth His loving devotion and His truth.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm when he fled from Saul and hid in a cave.
David was in danger.
God is in heaven.
God reaches down from heaven.
God saves me.
God rebukes those who attack me.
God sends His loving devotion.
God sends His truth.
passages.original: יִשְׁלַ֤ח מִשָּׁמַ֨יִם׀ וְֽיוֹשִׁיעֵ֗נִי חֵרֵ֣ף שֹׁאֲפִ֣י סֶ֑לָה יִשְׁלַ֥ח אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים חַסְדּ֥וֹ וַאֲמִתּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: My soul is among the lions; I lie down with ravenous beasts— with men whose teeth are spears and arrows, whose tongues are sharp swords.
passages.sermon:
My soul is in the middle of fierce enemies.
These enemies are like lions.
I lie down among people who are dangerous.
These people are like wild beasts.
Their teeth are like spears and arrows.
Their tongues are like sharp swords.
passages.original: נַפְשִׁ֤י׀ בְּת֥וֹךְ לְבָאִם֮ אֶשְׁכְּבָ֪ה לֹ֫הֲטִ֥ים בְּֽנֵי־ אָדָ֗ם שִׁ֭נֵּיהֶם חֲנִ֣ית וְחִצִּ֑ים וּ֝לְשׁוֹנָ֗ם חֶ֣רֶב חַדָּֽה׃

passages.text: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; may Your glory cover all the earth.
passages.sermon: God is above the heavens.\r\nGod is exalted.\r\nGod’s glory covers all the earth.
passages.original: ר֣וּמָה עַל־ הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם אֱלֹהִ֑ים עַ֖ל כָּל־ הָאָ֣רֶץ כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: They spread a net for my feet; my soul was despondent. They dug a pit before me, but they themselves have fallen into it! Selah My heart is steadfast, O God, my heart is steadfast. I will sing and make music.
passages.sermon:
Enemies set a trap for me.
They spread a net to catch my feet.
My soul felt crushed.
They dug a pit in front of me.
They fell into the pit themselves.
Selah.
My heart is firm, O God.
My heart is steady.
I will sing to You.
I will make music for You.
passages.original: רֶ֤שֶׁת׀ הֵכִ֣ינוּ לִפְעָמַי֮ כָּפַ֪ף נַ֫פְשִׁ֥י כָּר֣וּ לְפָנַ֣י שִׁיחָ֑ה נָפְל֖וּ בְתוֹכָ֣הּ סֶֽלָה׃ נָ֘כ֤וֹן לִבִּ֣י אֱ֭לֹהִים נָכ֣וֹן לִבִּ֑י אָ֝שִׁ֗ירָה וַאֲזַמֵּֽרָה׃

passages.text: Awake, my glory! Awake, O harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn.
passages.sermon:
David speaks in this psalm.
David is a servant of God.
David calls to his own soul.
He says, "Awake, my glory!"
He calls to his musical instruments.
He says, "Awake, O harp!"
He says, "Awake, O lyre!"
David will play music.
David will awaken the dawn with his praise.
passages.original: ע֤וּרָה כְבוֹדִ֗י ע֭וּרָֽה הַנֵּ֥בֶל וְכִנּ֗וֹר אָעִ֥ירָה שָּֽׁחַר׃

passages.text: I will praise You, O Lord, among the nations; I will sing Your praises among the peoples.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
David was the king of Israel.
David spoke to God.
David said, “I will praise You, O Lord.”
David said, “I will praise You among the nations.”
David said, “I will sing Your praises.”
David said, “I will sing Your praises among the peoples.”
passages.original: אוֹדְךָ֖ בָעַמִּ֥ים׀ אֲדֹנָ֑י אֲ֝זַמֶּרְךָ֗ בַּל־ אֻמִּֽים׃

passages.text: For Your loving devotion reaches to the heavens, and Your faithfulness to the clouds.
passages.sermon:
God shows loving devotion.
His loving devotion is very great.
His loving devotion reaches up to the heavens.
God is always faithful.
His faithfulness goes up to the clouds.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ גָדֹ֣ל עַד־ שָׁמַ֣יִם חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ וְֽעַד־ שְׁחָקִ֥ים אֲמִתֶּֽךָ׃

passages.text: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; may Your glory cover all the earth.
passages.sermon: God, You are above the heavens.\r\nYour glory fills all the earth.
passages.original: ר֣וּמָה עַל־ שָׁמַ֣יִם אֱלֹהִ֑ים עַ֖ל כָּל־ הָאָ֣רֶץ כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ׃
